report_name: OT Security Digest: Flaws in Cisco, ASUS, TP-Link & Satel Gear

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-76465
vulnerabilities.description: A remote code execution vulnerability in the MPLS OAM feature of Cisco Nexus 3000 and 9000 series switches could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute code with root privileges or cause a denial of service.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-14911
vulnerabilities.description: An arbitrary code execution vulnerability in ASUS routers allows an attacker to execute code via a crafted configuration file upload or by tricking a user into clicking a malicious link.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-19386
vulnerabilities.description: An arbitrary code execution vulnerability in ASUS routers allows an attacker to execute code via a crafted configuration file upload or by tricking a user into clicking a malicious link.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-105672
vulnerabilities.description: A set of high-severity vulnerabilities in TP-Link Tapo cameras allows an attacker on an adjacent network to bypass authentication, disrupt video streams, and predict local stream keys.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-5703
vulnerabilities.description: An authenticated path traversal vulnerability in Satel SenNet Dataloggers allows an authenticated user to read arbitrary files and list directories on the device.

indicators.name: Potential Cisco Nexus MPLS OAM Exploitation Attempt (CVE-2026-76465)
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Cisco Nexus MPLS OAM Exploitation Attempt (CVE-2026-76465)
id: 7c8d1e2f-3a4b-4c5d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects inbound MPLS OAM echo requests to Cisco Nexus switches from untrusted sources, which could indicate an attempt to exploit CVE-2026-76465.
references:
  - https://securityboulevard.com/2026/10/daily-ot-security-news-october-10-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-11
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: network
detection:
  selection:
    keywords:
      - 'MPLS OAM'
      - 'mpls echo request'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects network traffic patterns indicative of attempts to exploit a remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-76465) in the MPLS OAM feature of Cisco Nexus switches.

indicators.name: ASUS Router Arbitrary Code Execution Attempt
indicators.pattern:
title: ASUS Router Arbitrary Code Execution Attempt
id: 8b9c0d1e-2f3a-4b5c-8d9e-f0a1b2c3d4e5
status: experimental
description: Detects attempts to exploit arbitrary code execution vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-14911, CVE-2026-19386) in ASUS routers by accessing a specific CGI path used for configuration changes.
references:
  - https://securityboulevard.com/2026/10/daily-ot-security-news-october-10-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-11
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-uri-stem|contains: '/apply.cgi'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects web requests to '/apply.cgi' on ASUS routers, which could indicate an attempt to exploit code execution flaws CVE-2026-14911 or CVE-2026-19386.

indicators.name: Satel SenNet Datalogger Path Traversal Attempt (CVE-2026-5703)
indicators.pattern:
title: Satel SenNet Datalogger Path Traversal Attempt (CVE-2026-5703)
id: 9a0b1c2d-3e4f-4a5b-8c9d-e0f1a2b3c4d5
status: experimental
description: Detects path traversal attempts against Satel SenNet Dataloggers, potentially exploiting CVE-2026-5703.
references:
  - https://securityboulevard.com/2026/10/daily-ot-security-news-october-10-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-11
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri-query|contains:
      - '../../../../../etc/passwd'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects web requests containing path traversal sequences targeting sensitive files, indicative of attempts to exploit CVE-2026-5703 on Satel SenNet Dataloggers.
